name: pau_sero
description: P. aeruginosa OSA serogroup O1-O17 + wzyB marker (pasty)
note: 14 O-specific antigen gene cluster references (pasty pa-osa.fasta, Apache-2.0; same references as PAst 2.0, Thomassen 2016 doi:10.1128/JCM.00349-16): 13 serogroups (O1-O4, O6-O13, O15, O17) plus wzyB B-band marker. KNOWN LIMITATION: O5 absent; O5 strains cross-react with O2 (documented). Dual schemes: osa_serogroup + wzyb.

references.citation: Thomassen YCM, Kuijper EJ, van der Poll T, et al. Application of Whole-Genome Sequencing Data for O-Specific Antigen Analysis and In Silico Serotyping of Pseudomonas aeruginosa Isolates. J Clin Microbiol 2016;54(10):2760-6.
Petit RA III. pasty: a P. aeruginosa serotyper. GitHub 2021.

caveats: O5 is NOT in the reference set; O5 strains (PAO1) cross-react with O2 at 100%cov/99.8%id — same limitation as PAst/pasty
Serogroups O1-O4, O6-O13, O15, O17 are covered; O5, O14, O16 and novel OSA types are not
wzyB is reported in a separate scheme (B-band marker); its presence does not determine serogroup
Apache-2.0: CAN be bundled into the gapit wheel
